title: Positivity of the field degree
statement: Let $k,n$ be natural numbers with $1\le k\le n$, and define $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, where the ceiling denotes the least integer $m$ such that $2^m\ge n$. Then $d>0$.
